leadText: (Japanese: 偽ライジングボルテッカーズ登場！？ Enter the Fake !?) is the 138th episode of Pokémon Horizons: The Series, and the 1,370th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It is scheduled to air in Japan on May 29, 2026 .
